summary: GRI 12 provides information for organizations in the coal sector about their likely material topics, based on the sector's most significant impacts on the economy, environment, and people. It lists disclosures to report for each topic, drawn from the GRI Topic Standards and other sources.

questions.text: Describe how the organization manages the material topic of climate change: its actual and potential impacts, policies and commitments, actions taken, how effectiveness is tracked, and stakeholder engagement (GRI 3-3).
questions.hint: Topic 12.1 Climate change. Report per Disclosure 3-3: a. describe actual and potential, negative and positive impacts on the economy, environment and people, incl. human rights; b. whether involved through own activities or business relationships; c. policies or commitments; d. actions taken, incl. to prevent, mitigate or remediate impacts; e. how effectiveness is tracked; f. how stakeholder engagement informed actions.

parts.label: a. Actual and potential impacts (negative and positive) on the economy, environment and people, incl. human rights
b. Involvement in negative impacts (own activities or business relationships)
c. Policies or commitments
d. Actions taken (prevent / mitigate / remediate impacts; manage positive impacts)
e. How the effectiveness of the actions is tracked
f. How stakeholder engagement informed the actions
